title: pilocarpus racemosus var. heterochromus
intro: Pilocarpus racemosus var. heterochromus, commonly known as Jatamansi, is a plant species native to the Himalayas and other parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting sleep, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Jatamansi include its sedative, anxiolytic, and anticonvulsant properties, which are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Jatamansi include sesquiterpenoid lactones, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
